description: Nullability and parameter typing against MySQL: comparisons, BETWEEN, IN, NOT and OR over a NULL price read as NULL booleans while IS NULL and <=> do not; a CTE and a derived table before a RIGHT join read NULL ids where they have no row; a count subquery without GROUP BY reads 0; a parameter inside DATE_ADD(..., INTERVAL ? DAY) takes a number and one in a VALUES subquery takes the author's name; row comparisons and row IN lists type their parameters. MySQL rejects a column beside an aggregate without GROUP BY in its default mode, which the engine facts check.
